title: Retire the 64-only test_run_object_id_valid helper and route the duplicate inline record-id check through is_engram_record_id
outcome:
Each id/fingerprint kind has one validator, per the shared boundary contract.
- test_run_object_id_valid (src/test_run_evidence.rs:57) is removed or renamed for what it checks: a SHA-256 fingerprint.
- Its only remaining caller, the expectedFingerprint check at src/test_runs_disk.rs:651, uses the existing is_lowercase_sha256 (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:3866), and still rejects 32 hex.
- The inline record-id check at src/acceptance_evaluation.rs:394 (matches!(len, 32 | 64) && is_lowercase_hex) calls is_engram_record_id instead.
Behaviour is unchanged.
acceptance: Retire the 64-only test_run_object_id_valid helper and route the duplicate inline record-id check through is_engram_record_id is done
